title: Check the passage
introduction: Inspect three side bays; enter only the ones that are open.
explanation: A sensor asks a question without changing the world. if (frontIsClear()) executes its block only when the next square is accessible. When it is blocked, execution continues after the block.
objective: Leave one coin inside each open bay and none in the main corridor. Finish at (5, 1), facing east. Keep unused coins in the bag.
instruction: The starter already visits the three inspection points. Complete inspectBay() using if and frontIsClear(). After each inspection Karel must face east again.

commands.description: True when Karel can move one square forward.
Perform the block only when the passage is open.

hints: The helper turns north before your code and east afterwards.
Entering and returning both need move(). Use turnAround() at the far end.
Inside the if: move, put a coin, turn around, move back, turn around again.

illustration.alt: An open side bay can be entered and marked; a blocked bay is skipped. The sensor checks before any movement.
illustration.caption: An open side bay can be entered and marked; a blocked bay is skipped. The sensor checks before any movement.
